senses.gloss: (III)--one of the twenty Sutapa गणस्. वा. १००. १५; Br. IV. 1. १५.
--the goddess enshrined at कार्तिकेय. M. १३. ४५. [page३-022+ ४०]
--a Pratardana god. Br. II. ३६. ३१.

--a दुर्गा and विश्वरूपिनी who got शूल from शिव, cakra from विष्णु, शन्ख from वरुण, शक्ति from Agni, bow and arrow from Marut, Vajra from Indra, चषक from Kubera, दण्ड and पाश from Yama, कुण्टिक from ब्रह्मा, खड्ग and केट from मृत्यु, jewels from विश्व- karman. Br. IV. २९. ८०-8; ४४. ९०.

(I)--the wife of Nanda (gopa);
1: भा. I. 8. ३१; X. 2. 9; M. ४७. 7; Vi. IV. १५. ३१.
gave birth to a female child who was योगमाया incarnate. Without her knowledge, Vasudeva placed कृष्ण born on the same day in her bed and removed the girl to his residence. This was known to नारद.
2: Bha. X. 3. ४७-53; ३६. १७; वा. ९६. २०६-9.
Regarded कृष्ण as her own child; per- formed रक्षा to कृष्ण after his killing पूतना; her concern at कृष्ण's kicking the cart (शकटासुर) upside down, and शान्ति arranged; distressed at कृष्ण being carried away by the whirlwind (तृणावर्त); glad to see him alive; her con- cern at कृष्ण's eating mud, and wonder when he revealed his true form and the whole universe in his mouth; binding of कृष्ण with a rope for breaking the pot and stealing butter; took home कृष्ण playing on the river-bank; intense love to कृष्ण; joy at his escape from कालीय; surprise at कृष्ण holding Govardhana; recalled his exploits at Uddhava's visit, and gave him a hearty welcome.
3: भा. X. 6. १९-29; Chh. 7-9 (whole); ११. १४-20; १५. ४४; १७. १५; २५. ३०; ४६. २८-9.
Went to Syamanta- पञ्चक and was embraced with affection by रोहिणी and देवकी;
4: Ib. X. ८२. ३६-9.
represents the Mother Earth;
5: Br. III. ७१. २१२-3, २३६ and २३९.
remedy of, against बालदोष;
6: Vi. V. 1. ७७; 2, 3; 3. २०.
prayer of, to शकट;
7: Ib. V. 5. १२.
rope round the belly of कृष्ण for mischief.
8: Ib. V. 6. 7, १४; 7. २०.
[page३-023+ २४]
(II)--the mind-born daughter of उपहूत Pitr2s; wife of विश्वमहत्; mother of खट्वान्ग. Br. III. १०. ९०; वा. ७३. ४०-41.
(III)--a mind-born daughter of the हविष्मन्त- पितृस्, wife of अम्शुमान्, daughter-in-law of पञ्चजन, mother of दिलीप, and grandmother of भगीरथ. M. १५. १८-19.
--is कृष्ण. Br. III. ३३. २०.
--is कृष्ण. Br. III. ३६. २२.
--a queen of Brhanmanas and mother of Jaya- dratha. M. ४८. १०५; वा. ९९. ११५.
(I)--the wife कनकपीठ. Br. II. ११. ३५.
(II)--a daughter of Virocana and wife of त्वष्टा. Br. III. १८७.
(III)--a daughter of Devaka and one of the seven wives of Vasudeva. M. ४४. ७३.
--mother of कामदेव. वा. २८. ३०. [page३-024+ २६]
--a brother of शिशुनन्दि; ruled from Kili- किला. भा. XII. 1. ३२-3.
--a god of the Sumedhasa group. Br. II. ३६. ५९.
--the सभा of इशान in the eighth slope of Meru; bright with lustrous gold. वा. ३४. ९१.

--staves and cudgels, used by the barbarians against the enemies;
1: Vi. V. ३८. १७.
used by the आभिरस् against Arjuna.
2: Ib. V. ३८. ५२.
--a son of अर्काग्नि. Br. II. १२. ४३.
--an आर्षेय pravara (भार्गव). M. १९५. ३६.
--a भार्गव branch. Br. III. 1. १००.
